requests.why: To build the list of institution-wide Illumina agreement pages with published discount floors, and of cores that left Illumina over price, so a later agent can extract and date each discount percentage and migration. Single searches surfaced Iowa State, UC, Oxford, Illinois and Iowa Genomics; scaled queries should find 20 or more more.
